medications.purpose: Only if ibuprofen is not enough

return_now_warning_signs.text: Toes turning blue, cold, or numb
Severe pain not helped by medication

home_care_instructions.text: Keep your leg elevated above your heart when resting.
Use crutches - do not put weight on your right foot.

activity_and_diet_limits.text: No driving while taking opioid pain medication.
No showering with the splint on - keep it dry.
